'''Termites''' are a species of [[above ground]] [[vermin]] who may be found in any non-freezing [[biome]]. They live in mounds which can be spotted in the surface, and they can't be captured in [[animal trap]]s. Despite what their description indicates, they pose no danger to logs or wooden structures.

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] termites for their ''industrious nature'' and their ''ability to devour wood''.

[[File:Termites rush to damaged portion of mound.jpg|thumb|center|250px|Admired for its ''industrious nature''.]]

{{D for Dwarf}}
Research is underway on the easiest way to weaponize these wood-eating fiends as an assault force against elven forest retreats.
